description: This file defines the RequestWorkItem class, which represents a unit of work for handling a request within the Orleans runtime scheduler. It inherits from WorkItemBase and encapsulates a request message and its associated system target, providing execution logic and formatting support.

classes.name: RequestWorkItem
classes.description: A sealed class representing a work item for handling a request message in the Orleans scheduler.

methods.name: RequestWorkItem
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the work item with a target system entity and a message.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns a descriptive name for the work item, including the request ID.

methods.name: GrainContext
methods.description: Provides access to the associated system target context.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Executes the work item by invoking the target's request handler.

methods.name: TryFormat
methods.description: Attempts to format the work item as a string, including the request details, into a character span.
